description.value: Redpanda is the trust layer for the agentic enterprise.
Describes itself as a trust layer for the agentic enterprise, offering an Agentic Data Plane and a data streaming platform for real-time performance and AI workloads.
High performance data streaming platform and agentic data plane for enterprise real-time data infrastructure and AI agent operations; formerly known as Vectorized.

product_description.value: Redpanda Agentic Data Plane, which lets organizations build, connect, control and observe AI agents in production, built on the Redpanda Data Platform: Kafka API-compatible streaming and Redpanda Connect for integration.

Redpanda Data Platform with a Data Streaming Platform (Kafka API compatible), Redpanda Connect for linking systems across many sources and sinks, and Redpanda SQL for real-time analytics; Agentic Data Plane helps integrate, govern and control AI agents.

Redpanda Streaming (a Kafka-compatible engine written in C++), Redpanda Connect (over 300 connectors) and Redpanda SQL (a PostgreSQL-compatible OLAP engine), plus an Agentic Data Plane with agent identities and audit transcripts.

business_model_description.value: Subscription-based model with pricing tiers aligned to platform capabilities; another source says it follows a direct sales model.

customer_description.value: Companies that trust Redpanda include Activision, Akamai Technologies, Chess.com, Cisco Systems, Dun & Bradstreet, LiveRamp, Moody's, NYSE, Optimizely, Texas Instruments, Vodafone, Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies.

Target industries include financial services, technology, manufacturing, media, gaming and gambling, and cybersecurity; a third-party directory names Vodafone, StoneX, Akamai Technologies, Cisco Systems, Forex.com and SmartLunch as users.

revenue.value: About $42M (Datanyze estimate; not an official figure)
